questions.question: Paul was about to sail from Greece to Syria. What made him change his plans and go back through Macedonia?

answers.text: The Jews formed a plot against him
A storm kept the ships in port
The Spirit told him to wait

questions.question: Paul spoke to the believers in Troas until midnight. Why did he keep speaking for so long?

answers.text: He was ready to leave the next day
The crowd kept asking him questions
He was waiting for the others to arrive

questions.question: When the young man Eutychus fell from the third story while Paul was speaking, he was shaken up but fine. True or false?
After Eutychus fell from the third story, Paul embraced him. What did Paul say about the young man?

answers.text: The young man is still alive
